query: Equiatomic HfNbTaTiZr exhibits 8–16% room-temperature tensile ductility in the cast state and a yield strength of 163–530 MPa at 1000 °C at strain rates of 10−4–10−2 s−1, but inadequate oxygen resistance prevents most practical high-temperature applications. Earlier oxidation-protection research prevented pesting in a related, non-equiatomic Hf–Nb–Ta–Ti–Zr alloy during a 5 h exposure to air at 800 °C, but that result does not establish protection for equiatomic HfNbTaTiZr; related studies on other refractory alloys likewise did not evaluate this composition. With preservation of useful room- and high-temperature mechanical performance as a design constraint, what single intervention could improve the oxygen resistance of equiatomic cast HfNbTaTiZr? Formulate one hypothesis identifying the intervention and mechanism, predicting the outcome relative to untreated material, defining the applicable temperature, atmosphere, exposure-time, and loading boundaries, citing supporting evidence from the prior studies, and specifying a controlled experiment and result that would falsify the hypothesis.

generation.hypothesis: Applying a protective coating of aluminum oxide (Al2O3) to equiatomic HfNbTaTiZr will enhance its oxidation resistance at high temperatures.
generation.material_initial_state: Equiatomic HfNbTaTiZr in the cast state.
generation.conditions: High temperature (800 °C) in an air atmosphere for 5 hours.
generation.structural_mediator: Aluminum oxide coating acting as a barrier to oxygen diffusion.
generation.mechanism: The Al2O3 coating will prevent oxygen from reaching the underlying alloy, thereby reducing oxidation and pesting.
generation.predicted_outcome: The coated equiatomic HfNbTaTiZr will exhibit significantly improved oxidation resistance compared to the untreated material, with minimal weight gain due to oxidation.
generation.baseline: Untreated equiatomic HfNbTaTiZr exposed to air at 800 °C for 5 hours.
generation.boundary: The hypothesis is applicable at 800 °C in air for a duration of 5 hours.
generation.uncertainty: The exact degree of improvement in oxidation resistance is uncertain and may vary based on coating quality and application method.

falsification_experiment.design: Conduct a comparative study where one set of equiatomic HfNbTaTiZr samples is coated with Al2O3 and another set remains untreated. Both sets will be exposed to air at 800 °C for 5 hours.
falsification_experiment.falsification_rule: If the weight gain of the coated samples is not significantly lower than that of the untreated samples, the hypothesis will be falsified.
